subject: expn
title: EXPN.------PROG.CONT.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(II)-8. The prose above identifies: 'transformation, by its very definition, functions as a factor to reshape a given vibrational or physical universe situation. The realness of this phenomenon will comment on the changing nature of political and social dynamics.' The crossing diagrams how expansionism structurally meets progressional-continuance at the transformational-reshape scale: EXPN (expansionism) crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). EXPN sits at left with the subject-arrow; PROG-CONT at upper-right as partner-axis. ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) upper-left, DYM-FT (dynamic functionalism) upper-center, ACT (action) center as upper bridging chain. INFO-DY (information dynamics), MT-INFO (meta-information), PER-DY (perceived dynamics) on the right as partner outputs. APL-DT (applied dictates) center, IST-F-ACT (isolated-focus activism) lower-right. (R)INT (reality of intention), ECO-DY (economic dynamics), POL-P (political particulars) at lower-left as subject's downward chain. Structural argument: the upper chain ALT-FT -> DYM-FT -> ACT -> PROG-CONT routes the form's expansionism through alternative-functionalism and action into progressional-continuance.
